structs.name: Balise
structs.info: Defines a technical device on the railway trackbed.

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: fixed
attrs.info: Defines if the balise is fixed or virtual
attrs.label: Fixed

attrs.name: m_dup
attrs.info: Defines whether the information of the balise is a duplicate of the balise before or after
attrs.label: M_Dup

attrs.name: m_mcount
attrs.info: the purpose of message counter is to make it possible for the ERTMS/ETCS on-board to detect which balise group message the telegram belongs to.
attrs.label: M_Mcount

attrs.name: n_pig
attrs.info: position in the group. Defines the position of the balise in the balise group.
attrs.label: N_Pig

attrs.name: q_updown
attrs.info: Balise telegram transmission direction. This defines the direction of the information in the balise telegram. True when it is Up-link (Track-to-Train) and false when it is Down-link (Train-to-Track)
attrs.label: Q_Updown

attrs.name: verticallyOriented
attrs.info: Defines the orientation of the balise. false when oriented parallel to the sleepers
attrs.label: Vertically Oriented

attrs.name: standardSize
attrs.info: Defines if the balise is of standard size. false when balise is of reduced size
attrs.label: Standard Size

attrs.name: etcsPackets
attrs.info: Defines the ETCS packets associates to the Balise Group.
attrs.label: ETCS Packets

attrs.name: telegram
attrs.formatNote: Binary bit string representing the encoded ETCS telegram. The value shall consist of either exactly 341 bits (short telegram) or exactly 1023 bits (long telegram).
attrs.info: Defines the encoded ETCS telegram content of the balise
attrs.label: Telegram

attrs.name: telegramChecksum
attrs.info: Defines the checksum to verify the integrity of the stored telegram
attrs.label: Telegram Checksum

attrs.name: sleeperFastening
attrs.info: Defines the fastening system used for the balise on the sleeper
attrs.label: Sleeper Fastening

attrs.name: baliseMountingSystem
attrs.info: Defines the mounting system used for the balise
attrs.label: Balise Mounting System

attrs.name: designType
attrs.info: Defines the manufacturer type for the balise
attrs.label: Design Type

attrs.name: sleepersType
attrs.info: Defines the sleepersType on which the Balise was mounted
attrs.label: Sleepers Type

structs.name: BaliseGroup
structs.info: Defines a group of balises on the railway trackbed.

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: etcsMVersion
attrs.info: This gives the version of the ETCS system. Each part indicates the first and second number of the version respectively: The first number distinguishes not compatible versions (The three MSBs)_ The second number indicates compatibility within a version X. (The four LSBs)
attrs.label: ETCS M_version

attrs.name: q_link
attrs.info: true when the balise group is linked, otherwise, false (unlinked)
attrs.label: Q_Link

structs.name: BufferStop
structs.info: An infrastructure element installed at the end of a track to prevent rolling stock from moving beyond the track termination. It serves as the physical end point of the track and may provide energy absorption in the event of a train overrun.

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: dangerPoint
attrs.info: refers to the associated danger point
attrs.label: Danger Point

attrs.name: lengthOfBufferStop
attrs.info: Defines the length of the buffer stop from the buffer along the LinearElement.
attrs.label: LengthOfBufferStop

attrs.name: bsType
attrs.info: Defines buffer stop type
attrs.label: Buffer Stop Type

structs.name: Crossing
structs.info: Defines the physical track asset Crossing without possibility to switch between two linear elements

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: foulingPoints
attrs.info: refers to fouling points
attrs.label: Fouling Points

structs.name: DangerPoint
structs.info: a specific location on the railway where a potential conflict or danger may arise between trains or between trains and other object

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: name
attrs.info: User-friendly name, only if different from id
attrs.label: Name

attrs.name: topologicalCoordinate
attrs.info: Defines the point location on the linear element
attrs.label: Topological Coordinate

structs.name: ETCSEngineering
structs.info: Defines the container for the ETCS Engineering

attrs.name: engAreas
attrs.info: Defines the list of engineering areas
attrs.label: Eng Areas

attrs.name: locationAccuracyAreas
attrs.info: Defines the list of location accuracy areas
attrs.label: Location Accuracy Areas

attrs.name: kmAreas
attrs.info: Defines the list of km areas
attrs.label: Km Areas

structs.name: EngArea
structs.info: Defines the container for the Engineering area

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: topoArea
attrs.info: reference to the corresponding TopoArea
attrs.label: Topo Area

attrs.name: defaultSleepersType
attrs.info: Defines the default sleeper type
attrs.label: Default Sleepers Type

attrs.name: switches
attrs.formatNote: SlipCrossing can only reference two or four switches for single slip crossing and double slip crossing respectively
attrs.info: Defines the list of switches
attrs.label: Switches

attrs.name: crossings
attrs.info: Defines the list of crossings
attrs.label: Crossings

attrs.name: levelCrossings
attrs.info: Defines the list of level crossings
attrs.label: Level Crossings

attrs.name: baliseGroups
attrs.info: Defines the balise groups
attrs.label: Balise Groups

attrs.name: sleepers
attrs.info: Defines the list of sleepers
attrs.label: Sleepers

attrs.name: trackUsagePaths
attrs.info: Defines the list of track usage paths
attrs.label: TrackUsagePaths

attrs.name: dangerPoints
attrs.info: Defines the list of danger points
attrs.label: Danger Points

attrs.name: foulingPoints
attrs.info: Defines the list of fouling points
attrs.label: Fouling Points

attrs.name: bufferStops
attrs.info: Defines the list of buffer stops
attrs.label: Buffer Stops

structs.name: FoulingPoint
structs.info: the point on a railway track beyond which a train is not allowed to proceed if another train or object is occupying that portion of the track

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: name
attrs.info: User-friendly name, only if different from id
attrs.label: Name

attrs.name: topologicalCoordinate
attrs.info: Defines the point location on the linear element
attrs.label: Topological Coordinate

structs.name: KilometricPost
structs.info: An object that represents Kilometer information at specific location on a LinearElement

attrs.name: pos
attrs.info: position on the associated LinearElement
attrs.label: Pos

attrs.name: kilometer
attrs.info: Defines exact kilometer value
attrs.label: kilometer number

attrs.name: kmPostName
attrs.info: Name of the Kilometric Post.
attrs.label: kilometric post name

structs.name: KmArea
structs.info: Represents an area containing kilometre referencing information for one or more LinearElements. The kilometre values are defined through associated LinearElementKm profiles and their KilometricPosts.

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: topoArea
attrs.info: reference to the corresponding TopoArea
attrs.label: Topo Area

attrs.name: linearElementKm
attrs.info: Contains the kilometre referencing definitions for the LinearElements belonging to the area.
attrs.label: LinearElement Km

structs.name: LevelCrossing
structs.info: A level crossing is an intersection where a railway line crosses a road or a path at the same level. It can be used for the implementation of the ETCS trackside or to identify potential collision scenarios

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: dangerPoints
attrs.info: refers to danger points
attrs.label: Danger Points

structs.name: LinearElementAccuracyProfile
structs.info: Defines the positional accuracy of a LinearElement along its length, indicating how precisely its geometry is known or measured.

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: linearElement
attrs.info: reference to the corresponding LinearElement
attrs.label: LinearElement

attrs.name: offsetAccuracies
attrs.info: must be sorted in accending order according to offset from 0 to LinearElement.length
attrs.label: Offset Accuracies

structs.name: LinearElementKm
structs.info: Defines the kilometre referencing information for a LinearElement. It contains an ordered set of KilometricPosts that associate positions along the LinearElement with corresponding railway kilometre values.

attrs.name: linearElement
attrs.info: reference to the corresponding linear element
attrs.label: LinearElement

attrs.name: kilometricPosts
attrs.info: Defines the kilometre points on the track. These are sorted by pos from 0 to length
attrs.label: Kilometric Posts

structs.name: LocationAccuracyArea
structs.info: Represents an area containing positional accuracy definitions for one or more LinearElements. The accuracy information is provided through LinearElementAccuracyProfiles, which specify the expected positional deviation of the LinearElement geometry at defined offsets along its length.

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: topoArea
attrs.info: reference to the corresponding TopoArea
attrs.label: Topo Area

attrs.name: accuracyProfiles
attrs.info: Defines the accuracies for defined linear elements
attrs.label: Accuracy Profiles

structs.name: OffsetAccuracy
structs.info: Positional accuracy specified at a defined offset along a LinearElement.

attrs.name: offset
attrs.info: offset on the LinearElement with defined accuracy.
attrs.label: Offset

attrs.name: accuracy
attrs.info: defines absolute deviation of the offset as 1sigma
attrs.label: Accuracy

structs.name: Sleepers
structs.info: Sleepers are components on which the rails arranged with corresponding gauge.

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: linearElementSections
attrs.info: composes of linear element's sections
attrs.label: LinearElement Sections

attrs.name: sleepersType
attrs.info: defines sleepers type
attrs.label: Sleepers Type

structs.name: Switch
structs.info: A unit of track comprising two fixed rails (stock rails) and two movable rails (switch rails) used to direct vehicles from one track to another track.

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: foulingPoints
attrs.info: refers to fouling points
attrs.label: Fouling Points

attrs.name: tipShift
attrs.info: Defines the tip distance from the start of the switch on main and branching tracks
attrs.label: Tip Shift

attrs.name: bladeLength
attrs.info: Defines the length of the blade of switch along main and branching tracks
attrs.label: Blade Length

attrs.name: routeRequiresPointRight
attrs.info: list of trackUsagePaths that require this Switch to allow travelling through pointRight.
attrs.label: Route Requires Point Right

attrs.name: routeRequiresPointLeft
attrs.info: list of trackUsagePaths that require this Switch to allow travelling through pointLeft.
attrs.label: Route Requires Point Left

structs.name: TrackUsagePath
structs.info: A defined sequence of track elements and associated infrastructure forming a continuous operational path.

attrs.name: id
attrs.info: Identity of the object; used for referencing

attrs.name: switches
attrs.formatNote: SlipCrossing can only reference two or four switches for single slip crossing and double slip crossing respectively
attrs.info: Defines the list of switch(es)
attrs.label: Switches

attrs.name: derailers
attrs.info: Defines the list of derailer(s)
attrs.label: Derailers

attrs.name: levelCrossings
attrs.info: Defines the list of level crossings
attrs.label: Level Crossings

attrs.name: pathBody
attrs.info: List of linear references included in the track usage path.
attrs.label: Path Body

attrs.name: precedingTrackUsagePath
attrs.info: Defines the immediately preceding TrackUsagePath in the operational sequence.
attrs.label: PrecedingTrackUsagePath
